reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited text supports it: Section 2.1 expressly states no minimum quantity or purchase commitment and that declining further Order Forms is not a breach or shortfall, matching the rule's preferred position (fees for ordered services only).

Corroborating provisions are correctly read: Section 7.1 bars undisclosed minimum-use charges, Section 12.3 confirms no minimum-volume commitment, and Section 9.4 provides a without-cause exit with refund of prepaid Fees, so no take-or-pay or shortfall penalty exposure exists.
Consistent with a compliant finding, the redline is unchanged from the original paragraphs and no counterparty comment is proposed; deterministic checks flagged nothing.
